title: Concept: Peer dependency marked optional
description: package.json declares a peer marked optional, so an absent package goes unnoticed, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a peer marked optional, so an absent package goes unnoticed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a peer marked optional, so an absent package goes unnoticed.
